criteria.statement: DNS dashboard bootstraps zones, endpoints, policies, backends, and drift/audit state with nostr.queryUntilEose before live mode.
DNS dashboard keeps live REQ subscriptions open and updates collections from EVENT callbacks without REST DNS data fetches or manual refresh delivery.
DNS subscriptions use narrow filters containing DNS kinds and relevant tags such as #t, #family, and #event_type, scoped by Bahia service pubkey when known.
Parameterized replaceable DNS read models are deduped by author and d tag; tombstone replacements remove dashboard rows and stale replays do not restore them.
CLOSED and AUTH subscription failures are surfaced in visible connection error state.
